conversation.requestZip: Provide a local project ZIP. After upload, I’ll identify the framework, entry point, and migration boundaries, then ask you to confirm the migration method before making changes.
conversation.zipHint: Only local ZIP files are supported, up to {{size}}. The migration environment is retained for 1 hour after creation.

conversation.uploadThenAnalyze: Read-only analysis will start automatically after the ZIP upload completes.
conversation.analyzing: Codex is identifying the framework, entry point, and migration boundaries. No migration changes are being made.

conversation.analysisComplete: Read-only analysis is complete. Review the recommendation and confirm the final migration method.
conversation.awaitingUpload: The migration environment is ready. Select the local ZIP again to continue uploading.
conversation.expiredDescription: Migration content and output can no longer be previewed, downloaded, or deployed. If the Runtime deployment completed, return to the Agents page to continue using it.
conversation.unsupportedTitle: This ZIP cannot be migrated yet
conversation.unsupportedHint: Update the project as instructed, then create a new migration and upload it again.
conversation.cancelled: This migration was stopped. Create a new migration and upload the project again.
